name: Mapollage
tagline: Create KML files from geotagged photos
blurb: Mapollage has a varaity of settings that defines the end result that can be displayed in Google Earth and other programs.
description:
Mapollage has a varaity of settings that defines the end result
that can be displayed in Google Earth and other programs.

You control things like creation of Folders, Tracks,
Placemarks, Descriptions and of course, Photos.

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
